claims.fact: By Cade Onder Updated : Nov 13, 2026 12:44am UTC Add IGN on Google 0 0 GTA 6's fast-food hamburger chain, Burger Shot, is expanding with new locations across Florida starting this weekend thanks to a collaboration with Skinny Louie.

claims.fact: Last month, Burger Shot became available at the Kaseya Center , allowing fans to try the real version of the in-game restaurant during Miami Heat games, courtesy of a partnership with a fast-food joint known as Skinny Louie.
